title.narrative: NEW PR - Nepal (16-Jul-2015-15-Mar-2018)

description.narrative: Nepal, Malaria, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: To reduce the incidence of indigenous malaria cases by 80% and reduce the number of VDCs having indigenous malaria cases by 70% of current levels by 2017 relative to current levels (2013.). To sustain zero deaths due to malaria. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: To strengthen strategic information for decision making towards malaria elimination.. Objective 2: To further reduce malaria transmission and eliminate the foci gradually towards malaria elimination.. Objective 3: To improve quality of and access to early diagnosis and effective treatment of malaria towards malaria elimination.. Objective 5: To sustain support from the political leadership and the communities towards malaria elimination.. Objective 6: To strengthen programmatic, technical and managerial capacities towards malaria elimination.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for NPL-M-SCFP01
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Malaria test positivity rate
Reported malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for NPL-M-SCFP01
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities during the reporting period
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Percentage of confirmed cases fully investigated and classified
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of targeted risk groups receiving long-lasting insecticidal-nets
Proportion of population at risk potentially covered by long lasting insecticidal nets distributed
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Outcome indicators targets and results for NPL-M-SCFP01
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
